items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: During that time I met, in fact I played for Moms Mabley. Her name was Jackie Mabley then.

ctx.x: They were contemporaries, were'nt they, just about the same time?

I think Josephine was younger. During that time I met, in fact I played for Moms Mabley. Her name was Jackie Mabley then. And John Mason - oh, they were the most fabulous comedians. They were the same on the street. John Mason had a little baby just could barely talk. He'd stand on the street and everybody would be laughing. They'd go around the Tree of Hope and he had taught this kid every curse word in the book. If you walked up and said, 'Hello, how are you, little -' he'd call you rotten and then John Mason,…
